panel.empty_body: Headroom reads the sign-ins of Claude Code and the Codex CLI. Sign in to either and it shows up here automatically.

claude.hint: Run `claude` once to sign in or renew the session.

brand_colors.description: Color healthy meters with each provider's brand color instead of the theme's primary color.
brand_colors.label: Brand colors

critical_percent.description: Usage at or above this percentage is shown in the error color and triggers a notification.
critical_percent.label: Critical at (%)

notify.description: Notify once per window when usage crosses the critical threshold.
notify.label: Notifications

provider.description: Which providers this capsule shows. Auto shows only the one closest to its limit.
provider.label: Providers

refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch usage from each provider, in minutes. Failures retry sooner with backoff.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (min)

show_countdown.description: Show the time until the displayed window resets next to the percentage (horizontal bars only).
show_countdown.label: Show reset countdown

warn_percent.description: Usage at or above this percentage is shown in the warning color.
warn_percent.label: Warning at (%)

window.description: Which usage window the capsule shows for each provider.
window.label: Window
